hero.lead: Helping clients buy, sell, build and invest across Greater Houston, from a first home to an investment portfolio to a whole development.

divisions.title: Buyer Services
divisions.text: Personalized home searches and neighborhood tours, access to off-market and pre-list opportunities, and skilled negotiation through to close.

divisions.title: Seller Services
divisions.text: Detailed market analysis and pricing strategy, professional photography and videography, and a marketing plan across digital, print and social.

divisions.title: Investor Services
divisions.text: Income property sourcing, ROI analysis and cash flow projections, rehab oversight and ongoing asset management.

divisions.title: Developer Services
divisions.text: Land acquisition and feasibility insights, pre-development pricing and product strategy, and sales management from launch to sell-out.

about.title: Led by Kaleb Monroe
about.text: Kaleb Monroe is a Houston-based real estate entrepreneur, team leader and investor who has sold over $100 million in real estate. He founded the team to guide clients across residential, investment and development opportunities, and invests in small multifamily properties and renovation projects of his own. The team works under Real Broker, the national cloud-based brokerage.
